Righteousness is not facing east or west but belief in Allah, the Last Day, angels, Book and prophets, giving to those in need, prayer, zakah, keeping promises and patience.
Hasten to forgiveness and a garden as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for the righteous who spend, restrain anger, pardon people and seek forgiveness after sinning.
Allah wrote in the Psalms, after the earlier mention, that His righteous servants will inherit the land, and this Quran is a notification for worshipping people.
The home of the Hereafter is for those seeking neither exaltedness nor corruption, the righteous; a good deed brings better, and evil is repaid only in kind.
Allah created people from male and female, made them peoples and tribes to know one another, and the most noble of them before Allah is the most righteous.
The righteous, doers of good who slept little at night, asked forgiveness before dawn and gave the needy their right, will be among gardens and springs.
The righteous fulfill vows, fear a dreadful Day and feed the needy, orphan and captive only for Allah, who protects them and rewards their patience with a garden and silk.
The righteous one, who gives his wealth to purify himself, repaying no favor but seeking only his Lord's countenance, will be kept from the Fire and be satisfied.
